_comment: GitHub login -> Notion user ID. List them with: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $NOTION_TOKEN' -H 'Notion-Version: 2022-06-28' https://api.notion.com/v1/users | jq '.results[] | {name, id}'. Dashes optional. Unmapped logins are skipped silently so People columns never break, and malformed or all-zero IDs are dropped too - an ID that isn't a real workspace user makes Notion reject the entire page.
